failures.test: writeEvidenceRecord / readEvidenceRecord > roundtrip preserves every field
failures.rootCause: Recursive Dirent parent properties and path.relative separators were not normalized consistently across Bun/Windows, so a nested snapshot key did not round-trip as a portable slash path.

failures.rootCause: The test released x1 by name even when the shared pool had admitted t1 and t2 first; the asserted property is the global cap, not a cross-set admission order.
